securityContact: Email myoxus@blume29.de. Do not report security vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.
releasePolicy: Releases are made as needed and at least once per month. Security releases are made as needed and are not tied to a fixed release cycle.
disclosure: Coordinated disclosure is preferred. Do not publish exploit details before maintainers have assessed the report and agreed on a disclosure date.
scope: The Myoxus source tree and its documented release artifacts
The Rust server, Browser Web, Admin frontend, and supported deployment tooling
outOfScope: Third-party services and dependencies without a Myoxus-specific vulnerability
Unsupported platforms or locally modified deployments
Denial-of-service testing against public infrastructure without prior written approval
